
# **FAQs** {#faqs}

## *Do I HAVE to submit my data to ESS-DIVE?* {#do-i-have-to-submit-my-data-to-ess-dive?}

Yes, data must be either archived directly on ESS-DIVE or externally linked (see [*Data that's already been published*](#data-that’s-already-been-published)*)*.

## *The journal needs a data availability statement to proceed with the review process, but I haven’t finished my ESS-DIVE submission yet\! What can I do?* {#the-journal-needs-a-data-availability-statement-to-proceed-with-the-review-process,-but-i-haven’t-finished-my-ess-dive-submission-yet!-what-can-i-do?}

You can request a “pre-publish” DOI from ESS-DIVE for any draft submission. 

To start this process, click the “Publish” button on your draft dataset page to create a publication request. Within 15 minutes, you’ll receive an email confirming that ESS-DIVE has received your request. Reply to this email and let them know that you would like a pre-publish DOI for this dataset and that it isn’t ready for review yet.

## *What are ESS-DIVE’s data storage limits?* {#what-are-ess-dive’s-data-storage-limits?}

![][image5]

*What is the most time-consuming part of submission?*

The most time-consuming part of the submission process is the data preparation. See [Step 2 | Preparing your data package](#step-2-|-preparing-your-data-package) above. ESS-DIVE also has an [easy-to-use guidebook](https://docs.ess-dive.lbl.gov/) with a wealth of information on submitting a data package.

## *How long does the review process take?* {#how-long-does-the-review-process-take?}

The review process typically takes a few days. You will receive an email confirming your submission, and then another email with any requested changes.

*How should ESS-DIVE data be cited?*

Once published, your data package will get a DOI and citation just like a scientific publication. See example below:

[Ehosioke S; Adebayo M B; Bailey V L; Peixoto R B; Emmanuel E D; Machado-Silva F; Regiers P J; Spanbauer T; Thomas S P; Ward N D; Weintraub M N; Doro K O (2023): **Soil architecture and subsurface stratigraphic heterogeneities across land-lake interfaces along Lake Erie.** COMPASS-FME, ESS-DIVE repository. Dataset. doi:10.15485/2202344](https://data.ess-dive.lbl.gov/view/doi%3A10.15485%2F2202344)

## *What if I need to change something after the data package is accepted?* {#what-if-i-need-to-change-something-after-the-data-package-is-accepted?}

The data package can always be edited after publishing. Changes to the metadata will be updated immediately, but any changes to the uploaded files require re-review.
